chunks.chunk: to be x do: Is…? / Does…?
chunks.tip: O ponto que mais trava no A1! Com lugar, idade, profissão, sentimento → to be (am/is/are). Com ação de rotina (work, live, like) → do/does. Nunca junte os dois: Are you work? ❌ → Do you work? ✅
examples: Is Jenny on the train? Yes, she is.
Does his cousin work on that train? Yes, he does.
Tony isn't on the train. He doesn't work there.

chunks.chunk: did + verbo normal: Did you get it back?
chunks.pt: Você pegou de volta? (passado com did)
chunks.tip: Get it back = pegar de volta. E a regra de ouro do passado: o did já carrega o passado, então o verbo volta ao normal. Did you got? ❌ → Did you get? ✅. She didn't got ❌ → She didn't get ✅.
examples: So, did you get it back, Jenny?
But her suitcase didn't get off!

chunks.chunk: there is / there are + loads of
chunks.tip: Loads of = um monte de (bem informal, nativo fala o tempo todo). Pra uma coisa: there is (there's). Pra várias: there are. No passado: there was / there were.
